name: Sample Agent
description: The worked example of a catalogue entry: a subagent that declares neither an input nor an output schema.

name: work-planner
description: Turns a specification into an ordered work plan of tasks, with dependencies, risks and acceptance criteria.

specPath.description: Path to the specification the work plan is derived from.

reviewNotesPath.description: Optional path to review notes that constrain the plan.

workPlanId.description: Identifier of the generated work plan, for example WP-001.

workPlanPath.description: Path of the generated work plan document.

taskCount.description: Number of executable tasks the plan decomposes into.

name: task-executor
description: Executes a single task file end to end, red-green-refactor, writing only the files the task nominates.

taskFilePath.description: Path to the executable task file.

filesChanged.description: Absolute paths of every file the task wrote.

reason.description: Typed reason, present only when the status is blocked.
